## Approve Purchase Order (Ap)

Decides the current chain step by REUSING the shared `ApproveChainStepCommand` (Legal's block, second real consumer), then adds the procurement consequence: chain complete → PO `approved` + total COMMITTED against the linked budget; rejection → PO `rejected`, nothing committed. Step role labels (Manager / Finance / VP) are positional per the stored route.

### Example

Natural target: the linked PO-2026-0042 — Finance has approved, the VP step is pending; running this command with `approved` completes the chain and commits $52,000.

### Non-goals

No approver identity enforcement (any operator may decide any step in v1 — the chain records who/when; role-based authz is a platform concern). No delegation flow beyond what the shared step field already carries.
